references.text: The original account of the death of Nadab and Abihu when they offered strange fire before the Lord. This is the main text that Numbers 26:61 refers back to.
An earlier reference in Numbers that also mentions the death of Nadab and Abihu due to offering strange fire, and that they had no sons.
Nadab and Abihu are mentioned as sons of Aaron, showing their lineage and position as priests.
Nadab and Abihu are mentioned together with Aaron and the seventy elders when they went up the mountain to meet God.
The books of Chronicles confirm that Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons.
The context for the rules on approaching the Lord's sanctuary, given after the death of Nadab and Abihu, as a warning against unauthorized approach.
